title: *20* HOOKS
THAT WORK
subtitle: Openers that stop the scroll in the first three seconds. Fill in the blanks, film it, post it.
tagline: From the reel: "This video already lost you"

blocks.heading: The first 3 seconds *decide everything*
blocks.intro: Most reels don't flop because of the algorithm. They lose people before the hook even lands. Three rules before you use any hook in this file:
steps: Open with the result, not a greeting
Nobody stays for "Hey guys." Your first sentence is the hook. Say it in the first two seconds.
A still first frame gets scrolled past. Start mid-action: a cut, a zoom, text popping in, your hand already moving.
Put the payoff on screen first. The how comes after the viewer has a reason to stay.
blocks.note: How to use this file: pick one hook, swap the [highlighted blanks] for your own details, and put the hook on screen as text while you say it.

items.line: I got [result] in [time] by changing one thing.
items.example: I got 40,000 views in two days by changing my first frame.
items.why: A concrete result plus "one thing" makes the fix feel easy to steal.

items.line: This is what [result] looks like. Here's how I made it.
items.example: This is what a 1M-view reel looks like before the edit. Here's how I made it.
items.why: The payoff is on screen before you ask for any attention.

items.line: Stop [common habit] if you want [goal].
items.example: Stop saying "hey guys" if you want people to stay.
items.why: Viewers check whether they do it, and they stay to find out.

items.line: You're losing [audience] at second [number]. Here's why.
items.example: You're losing half your viewers at second two. Here's why.
items.why: A precise number feels measured, and the loss is personal.

items.line: The [thing] mistake every [audience] makes.
items.example: The caption mistake every new creator makes.
items.why: "Every" includes the viewer, so they need to know which one it is.

items.line: [Popular advice] is why your [thing] isn't working.
items.example: Posting every day is why your reels aren't growing.
items.why: It flips advice they already follow, and that demands an answer.

items.line: Everyone tells you to [advice]. Do [opposite] instead.
items.example: Everyone tells you to use trending audio. Use your own voice instead.
items.why: Disagreeing with the crowd signals you know something they don't.

items.line: I tried [thing] for [time]. Here's what happened.
items.example: I posted at 6am for 30 days. Here's what happened.
items.why: A real experiment with an unknown ending is hard to scroll past.

items.line: Nobody talks about this part of [topic].
items.example: Nobody talks about this part of going viral.
items.why: It promises information the viewer hasn't seen anywhere else.

items.line: Watch what happens when I [action].
items.example: Watch what happens to my views when I cut the first two seconds.
items.why: It sets up a visible before and after the viewer waits to see.

items.line: [Number] [things] that [result], and number [x] surprised me.
items.example: Three edits that doubled my watch time, and number two surprised me.
items.why: A short list feels quick, and the surprise keeps them to the end.

items.line: I've [done thing] [big number] times. Only one [thing] works every time.
items.example: I've posted 400 reels. Only one hook works every time.
items.why: Experience at scale earns trust in one sentence.

items.line: [Time] ago I had [before]. Today I have [after].
items.example: Six months ago I had 200 followers. Today I have 50,000.
items.why: Before and after is the oldest story shape there is, and it still works.

items.line: This [post / reel / email] changed everything for me.
items.example: This one reel changed everything for my account.
items.why: A turning point makes the viewer want the same moment.

items.line: If you [situation] and still [problem], watch this.
items.example: If you post every day and still get 200 views, watch this.
items.why: The right viewer feels seen and stops scrolling instantly.

items.line: Save this before your next [task].
items.example: Save this before you film your next reel.
items.why: It frames the reel as a tool, and saves push it to more people.

items.line: [Option A] vs [Option B]. One of them gets [result].
items.example: Talking head vs B-roll first. One of them gets ten times the views.
items.why: People guess before the answer, and guessing keeps them watching.

items.line: Here's what [experts] do that nobody shows you.
items.example: Here's what big creators do in the first frame that nobody shows you.
items.why: Behind-the-scenes access feels exclusive.

items.line: Don't scroll. This takes [time] and fixes [problem].
items.example: Don't scroll. This takes 20 seconds and fixes your hook.
items.why: It names the scroll out loud and makes the cost of staying tiny.

items.line: Try this in your next [thing] and tell me what happens.
items.example: Try this in your next reel and tell me what happens to your views.
items.why: It turns watching into doing, and the replies boost the post.

blocks.heading: Before you *post*
items: The hook is said in the first two seconds, with no greeting before it.
The hook is on screen as text, big and readable.
Something moves in the very first frame.
The result is shown before it is explained.
The ending tells people exactly what to do next.
blocks.closing: Pick one hook. Film it today. *Ship it.*
